Then, make an attempt to go south. After that, make an attempt to venture south. With that accomplished, venture east. And then, head south. And then, take the American key from the mantle in the silent study. And then, make an effort to go west. With that done, unlock the American box. And then, make absolutely sure that the American box within the launderette is opened. Then, take the keycard from the American box in the launderette. That's it!
